description: Plan a complete Pixel Art Generator educational-app pack that consumes, validates, and packages Forge public-MCP source and derived delivery
deviation_notes: Prerequisite: rigid_animation_sprite_pipeline_20260717 (and transitively Forge–Pixel interchange, novel identity, and upstream authoring tracks) must complete before implementation begins. Pixel Art Generator consumes, validates, and packages Forge public-MCP outputs; Forge preserves source frames and GLBs and produces derived atlases, contact sheets, and clip metadata rather than sharing its filesystem.

sprint.goal: Let Pixel Art Generator consume, validate, and package one complete educational-app pack from Forge public-MCP source and derived delivery under the exact education-app-pack-profile/v1 completeness contract.
